questions.question: In Spanish football, which team's goalkeeper was given a 12-match ban following a fatal on-pitch collision?
questions.explanation: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono received a 12-game suspension from the Royal Spanish Football Federation following the tragic incident.
questions.context: 2026–27 Segunda División: In association football, the Royal Spanish Football Federation suspends FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono for 12 matches following a collision with CD Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel during a November 2 match, which resulted in de Miguel's death.

questions.question: Which country won the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia hosted in Bangkok?
questions.explanation: Carmelle secured victory for the Philippines performing the entry Sobra-Sobra.
questions.context: Eurovision Song Contest Asia: The Philippines, with the song "Sobra-Sobra" by Carmelle, wins the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia held in Bangkok, Thailand.

questions.question: More than 100,000 people took to the streets in nationwide civil unrest organised by students and unions in which European country?
questions.explanation: Demonstrations across France saw over 100,000 protesters take part alongside yellow vest activists.
questions.context: 2026 European unrest > 2026 French civil unrest: Student protesters, unions, and the yellow vests hold another nationwide protest in France, with over 100,000 participants.

questions.question: Border guards in Bangladesh intercepted a smuggling attempt near the Indian border, seizing a haul of which illegal item?
questions.explanation: Border Guard Bangladesh seized 48 explosive gel sticks alongside detonators and fuses during an operation in Sylhet District.
questions.context: Crime in Bangladesh: Border Guard Bangladesh seize 48 high-power explosive gel sticks, 100 detonators, and 11 fuses during an operation along the Bangladesh–India border in Kanaighat Upazila, Sylhet District, Bangladesh.

questions.question: Health officials in Bangladesh reported a rising death toll from an outbreak of which mosquito-borne virus?
questions.explanation: Eight additional deaths in Bangladesh brought the country's annual dengue fatality total to nearly 500.
questions.context: Eight more people in Bangladesh are reported to have died from dengue fever, bringing this year's outbreak's death toll to 491.
